articles.title_en: A Russian firm has frozen construction of a laptop factory in Yekaterinburg. It will make drone simulators for schoolchildren instead.
articles.lead_en: LIGA Group has frozen plans to build a laptop factory in Yekaterinburg, according to General Director Alexey Lezhnin, who spoke to the Russian business outlet RBC. The plant had been scheduled to open at the Kosmos industrial park in 2027.

articles.title_en: London club cancels Instasamka concert after complaint from Russian emigre group over alleged donations to Russian troops
articles.lead_en: The London club For Your Eyes Only has canceled a concert by blogger and singer Instasamka (real name Daria Zoteeva) scheduled for November 14. The decision followed a complaint from Ksenia Maksimova, who founded the London-based Russian Democratic Society, according to the Russian news outlet Echo.
